node.title: Re: split problem
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [rmarkman],

Some more info for your [doc://perlbug|bug report]: I reduced the test case down to perl -e '$_="Boo";@x=split/o/;$#x=1;$x[1]=0', and a git bisect shows the first bad commit is [https://perl5.git.perl.org/perl.git/commit/4ecee209f85984e2bab6cc57c1bf8429c45778c0|4ecee209] (the first release that contains this commit appears to be v5.21.5).

Regards,
-- Hauke D
